title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
description:
About FION

European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly.

We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently.

We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors.

We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work.

You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders.

Tasks

Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact.

Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows.

Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

What you’ll do:

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

What you bring:

  • You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 4 months (6 preferred) and based in Berlin.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an Client Experience Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

What you’ll do:

  • Support our clients: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

What you bring:

  • You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets and AI tooling. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 6 months and based in Berlin.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.

We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served

Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.

Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany or the UK, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin.

Segmented Messaging

  • Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)

  • Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists

  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow

  • Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated

  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning

Solution Development

  • Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features

  • Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures

  • Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments

GTM Readiness

  • Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language

  • Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed

  • Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure

  • Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play

  • Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact


What you will bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning

  • Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists

  • Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations

  • Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment

  • Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.

  • Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: Customer Success & Onboarding (m/w/d) – Teilzeit, 20 Std./Woche
description:
Baue einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf

Novo AI ist ein Technologieunternehmen aus Hannover. Mit unserer WatchMen-Plattform und KI-Sensorik helfen wir produzierenden Unternehmen, Maschinenzustände, Stillstände und Produktionskennzahlen transparent zu machen und ihre Fertigung besser zu verstehen.

Damit unsere Kunden schnell starten und unsere Lösungen im Alltag sicher nutzen können, bauen wir unser Onboarding und Customer Success von Grund auf auf. Dafür suchen wir dich in Teilzeit mit zunächst 20 Stunden pro Woche. Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden persönlich und entwickelst zugleich wiederverwendbare Inhalte und intelligente Abläufe. Du kannst Verbesserungen selbst vorantreiben und arbeitest dabei mit Kollegen zusammen, die dich bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. Unser Ziel: mehr Kunden gut begleiten und den manuellen Aufwand pro Kunde reduzieren.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Customer Success aufbauen: Du lernst die zugeteilten Kunden, ihre Ansprechpartner, Ziele und offenen Anliegen kennen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Team entwickelst du einen klaren Weg vom ersten Einführungsgespräch bis zur regelmäßigen Nutzung von WatchMen.

  • Onboarding-Workflows gestalten: Du definierst nachvollziehbare Schritte, Zuständigkeiten und Meilensteine – etwa Begrüßung, Kick-off, Plattform-Einführung, erste Anwendung und Folgetermine. Auch Bestandskunden, die bisher wenig Begleitung hatten, holst du gezielt ab.

  • Onboarding-Videos und Hilfen entwickeln: Du planst und erstellst kurze, verständliche Videos zur Plattform sowie Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen, Checklisten und Antworten auf häufige Fragen – eigenständig oder gemeinsam mit Kollegen. Du baust eine gut auffindbare Wissensbasis auf, mit der Kunden typische Fragen selbst klären können.

  • Skalierbare Abläufe und Automatisierung gestalten: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Arbeit und entwickelst sinnvolle Lösungen, zum Beispiel für Terminbuchung, Onboarding-Erinnerungen, Aufgabenübergaben und Nachverfolgung. Du nutzt passende digitale Werkzeuge und setzt um, was du selbst umsetzen kannst. Programmierung, Schnittstellen und komplexere technische Umsetzung übernimmst du gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Kollegen; du musst dafür nicht selbst programmieren können.

  • Aus Kundensicht denken: Du verstehst, was Kunden beim Einstieg brauchen, wo Unsicherheit entsteht und welche Informationen sie wann wirklich weiterbringen. Du gestaltest das Onboarding verständlich, in passenden Schritten und ohne Informationsüberflutung. Dabei verbindest du Einfühlungsvermögen und ein Verständnis für Lernen, Motivation und Vertrauen mit konkreten Hilfen für den Arbeitsalltag.

  • Persönlichen Kundenkontakt halten: Du führst Teams-Meetings und Telefonate, erklärst Funktionen verständlich und begleitest Kunden bei ihren nächsten Schritten. Du erkennst, welche Fragen eine persönliche Antwort brauchen und welche sich durch gute Inhalte oder Prozesse einfacher lösen lassen.

  • Anliegen bis zur Klärung nachhalten: Du nimmst Rückfragen und Probleme auf, priorisierst sie mit dem Team und koordinierst technische Themen mit Entwicklung und Technik. Du hältst Kunden über den Stand auf dem Laufenden und prüfst nach, ob die Lösung hilft.

  • Kundeninformationen strukturiert pflegen: Du dokumentierst Kontakte, Absprachen, Onboarding-Fortschritt und offene Aufgaben im CRM bzw. in unserer zentralen Kundenübersicht. Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen und Übergaben auch für andere im Team verständlich sind.

  • Verbesserungen nachvollziehbar machen: Du beobachtest mit uns, wo Kunden im Onboarding hängen bleiben, welche Fragen häufig wiederkehren und wie viel Betreuungszeit benötigt wird. Du verbesserst Inhalte und Abläufe anhand von Kundenfeedback, Plattformnutzung und Zeitaufwand – mit dem Ziel, mehr Kunden bei verlässlicher Betreuungsqualität zu begleiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Perfektes, verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift ist die wichtigste Voraussetzung. Du führst Telefonate und Teams-Gespräche souverän auf Deutsch, verstehst Rückfragen präzise und erklärst auch komplexere Zusammenhänge klar.

  • Du verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens auf B2-Niveau; C1 ist wünschenswert. So kannst du dich auch mit englischsprachigen Kollegen abstimmen und englische Tools und Unterlagen sicher nutzen.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich, verbindlich und aufmerksam, hörst gut zu und bleibst auch bei unzufriedenen Kunden sachlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert: Du behältst Termine und offene Aufgaben im Blick, hältst Zusagen ein und fragst gezielt nach, wenn dir Informationen fehlen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, neue Abläufe aufzubauen und dich in digitale Produkte einzuarbeiten. Du gehst sicher mit Videokonferenzen, E-Mail und digitalen Arbeitswerkzeugen um.

  • Du bringst drei bis fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Customer Success oder im Kunden-Onboarding mit. Du hast Kunden bereits eigenständig betreut, Gespräche geführt und Anliegen zuverlässig bis zur Klärung begleitet. Diese Erfahrung ist eine zentrale Voraussetzung für die Rolle.

  • Du weißt, wie man Onboarding und Customer Success skalierbar gestaltet: durch sinnvolle Standards, wiederverwendbare Inhalte, passende digitale Tools und gezielte Automatisierung. Du kannst Kundenbedürfnisse und typische Hürden in einen klaren Ablauf übersetzen und erklären, welche Schritte du selbst umsetzt und wo du Unterstützung brauchst.

  • Programmierkenntnisse sind keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind dein Verständnis für Kundenprozesse, deine Fähigkeit, gute Lösungen zu konzipieren, und die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen, die die technische Umsetzung unterstützen.

  • Du kannst die Bedienung einer Software verständlich erklären und daraus brauchbare Schulungsinhalte entwickeln. Erfahrung mit Bildschirmaufnahmen, kurzen Erklärvideos oder einer Wissensdatenbank ist ein Vorteil.

  • Besonders von Vorteil sind Berührungspunkte mit B2B-Kunden, Produktion, Fertigung, Industrie oder technischer Software. Das erleichtert dir den Einstieg in die Themen unserer Kunden. Branchenwissen ist ein Plus; ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist keine Voraussetzung.

Arbeitsort, Arbeitszeit und Kundenbesuche

Du startest mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. Die Verteilung stimmen wir gemeinsam ab, damit unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden zu vereinbarten Zeiten eine verlässliche Ansprechperson haben. Bei Remote-Arbeit aus einer anderen Zeitzone sollten diese Kontaktzeiten ebenfalls möglich sein.

Du kannst weltweit remote arbeiten. Die Zusammenarbeit bei uns in Hannover ist willkommen und bevorzugt, wenn es für dich passt. Nähe zu Hannover ist ein Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Gelegentliche persönliche Besprechungen bei uns – zum Beispiel ein- bis zweimal im Monat – sind nach Absprache möglich und freiwillig.

Wenn du deine Kunden auch persönlich kennenlernen möchtest, kannst du sie nach Abstimmung vor Ort besuchen, beispielsweise ein- bis zweimal im Monat oder seltener. Kundenbesuche sind vollständig optional; es gibt keine verpflichtende Reisequote. Für vereinbarte Besuche stellen wir ein Firmenfahrzeug zur Verfügung. Alternativ kannst du öffentliche Verkehrsmittel oder nach Absprache dein eigenes Fahrzeug nutzen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Eine Teilzeitrolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf und verbindest persönliche Kundenbetreuung mit wiederverwendbarem Onboarding und Automatisierung.

  • Unterstützung durch unsere Kollegen: Du kannst Ideen eigenständig umsetzen und für technische Fragen, Programmierung, Inhalte oder Integrationen mit dem Team zusammenarbeiten. Du wirst schrittweise in WatchMen, unsere Lösungen und die Kundenanwendungen eingearbeitet.

  • Persönlicher Kontakt zu Menschen aus produzierenden Unternehmen und eine Aufgabe, bei der verständliche Kommunikation und verlässliches Nachhalten einen konkreten Unterschied machen.

  • Eine Bruttovergütung von 18.000 bis 24.000 Euro pro Jahr für 20 Wochenstunden, abhängig von Erfahrung und Profil.

Dein Einstieg

Zu Beginn lernst du WatchMen, das Team und deine Kunden kennen und sammelst die wichtigsten offenen Themen. Gemeinsam priorisieren wir die häufigsten Hürden aus Kundensicht. Daraus entwickelst du einen ersten Onboarding-Ablauf und wenige besonders hilfreiche Videos oder Anleitungen. Du planst eine passende erste Automatisierung und setzt sie eigenständig oder mit unseren technischen Kollegen um. Du erprobst diese Bausteine mit ausgewählten Kunden, holst Feedback ein und baust sie schrittweise aus. Persönliche Teams-Termine und Telefonate bleiben Teil der Betreuung. Prioritäten und Umfang stimmen wir auf deine 20-Stunden-Woche ab.

Möchtest du Customer Success bei Novo AI mit aufbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu deiner bisherigen Kundenbetreuung. Erzähle uns gern von einem Onboarding-Prozess oder einer Verbesserung, an der du mitgewirkt hast, und nenne deinen möglichen Starttermin sowie die gewünschte Verteilung deiner 20 Wochenstunden.

description:
Your Responsibilities

We are looking for a new colleague to join the Office of the Vice President International and University Development in Berlin. The position is academically affiliated with the Vice President International and University Development and works closely with the International Office, faculties, programme directors and international partner institutions. In this position you will support the Vice President in the day-to-day coordination of priorities and activities while also taking an active role in the development and implementation of UE’s international academic partnerships, teaching collaborations, programmes and strategic initiatives. The position combines academic and organisational support, coordination of international teaching and cooperation projects, research and strategic development. It serves as an important interface between the Vice President International, academic and administrative units across UE and international partner universities, helping to ensure that ongoing activities and new initiatives are effectively prepared, coordinated and followed through.

Key Activities & Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate ongoing international teaching collaborations, including coordination of lecturers and communication with academic partners
  • Support the development and coordination of international academic projects and cooperation formats, as well as contributing to the development and implementation of UE’s Internationalisation and Sustainability Strategies and related strategic initiatives.
  • Conduct research, benchmarking and analysis on international higher education, academic structures, potential partners and relevant international developments
  • Provide academic and organisational support to the Vice President International in day-to-day activities
  • Maintain project documentation and monitor responsibilities, deadlines and next steps across ongoing international projects
  • Prepare briefings, presentations, background information and decision-making materials for the Vice President International

Your profile

  • University degree at Master’s level or equivalent in social sciences, humanities, international relations, education, management or another relevant field; a PhD is an advantage but not required

  • Structured, proactive and reliable working style with a high level of independence

Why us?

title: Senior Controller / FP&A Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen - willkommen in unseren Paradiesen

Wir bei Therme Horizon schaffen besondere Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste – und entwickeln gleichzeitig unsere Unternehmensgruppe kontinuierlich weiter. Dafür bauen wir aktuell gemeinsam mit einem internationalen Finanzinvestor eine zentrale Holdingorganisation und moderne Finance-Strukturen auf.

Als Teil unseres neu aufgebauten Group-FP&A-Teams übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der gruppenweiten finanziellen Steuerung. Du verbindest klassische FP&A-Aufgaben mit Business Performance Management, strategischer Analyse und dem Aufbau moderner Finance-Prozesse.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Holding, unseren lokalen Finance-Teams und dem operativen Management unserer Standorte zusammen. Deine Themen begleitest du von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.

  • Planning & Forecasting: Verantwortung für Budget, Rolling Forecast und Mittelfristplanung – von der Prozessgestaltung und Abstimmung mit den Standorten bis zu Konsolidierung und Analyse

Skills und Werte die zu uns passen

title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

You will work on applications that use deep learning and satellite data and other data sources to help companies and governments fight deforestation, monitor critical infrastructure, and respond faster and more precisely to natural disasters. Our aim is to empower any user in the world to harness the power of earth observation satellites to simplify and improve their daily work.

As one of the most senior engineers on our product team, you will architect, design and implement new features and refactorings from initial idea to production release and then monitoring and maintenance, often in temporary cross-functional squads.  Concrete topics you would work on are, for example, the rendering and querying of large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in mobile app, browser and backend, writing the database queries that make that fast, implementing smart logic on this data and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.


Your challenge

Key responsibilities

  • Build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Architect and build services that integrate large amounts of heterogenous data to enable users to prioritize a vast number of competing tasks
  • Own the next major evolution of our public API 
  • Drive the continuous development of our agentic solutions
  • Lead cross-functional teams, driving new feature developments from very early in a topic, through discovery, design, architecture to release and maintenance. Take real ownership 
How we work
Our development lifecycle is a pragmatic scrumban: structured enough to coordinate, loose enough to move fast. Engineers here have real autonomy - you will make plenty of decisions yourself, and you will have senior engineers to think out loud with on the ones that carry more weight. Asking is normal here, at every level.
We take agentic development seriously but we are, sometimes painfully, aware of its limits. Tickets with solid acceptance criteria become agentic specs that agents implement in test-driven setups. Code review is a mix of agent and human - whichever is most effective for the change at hand. We ship to production at least weekly. And we actively encourage engineers to keep coding and debugging manually to stay sharp; the goal is augmented engineers, not engineers who've forgotten how to program.

Stack
  • Frontend: React, Typescript
  • Backend: NestJS, Prism, Typescript
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: Gitlab


Your profile

Must have

  • Expert backend experience with ideally NestJS, Express, or Node.js
  • A very good understanding of cloud architecture
  • Solid TypeScript and React in production (Vue, Preact or Angular also fine — we care that you know a component model well, not which one)
  • You've used AI-assisted coding in your actual day-to-day, not just tried it once
Nice to have
  • Spec-driven or test-driven development, agentic or otherwise
  • Python - even better if you were previously exposed to many other different programming paradigms
  • Web-based geospatial / GIS work
  • An eye for design and UX — enough to make small design calls without needing a mockup for everything
You do not need all of the "nice to haves," and you do not need to match every "must have" perfectly. If you read this and think you'd be a good fit but you're missing a line item, apply and tell us what you'd bring instead.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

title: Legal AI Engineer (Berlin or Leipzig)
description:
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in Leipzig or Berlin.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. title: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development
description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer, you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Industrial Robotics & Automation 
You will be responsible for the setup, commissioning, and operation of internal and customer automation systems. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Configuring, parameterizing, and commissioning industrial robots from different manufacturers on our shop floor and at customer sites 
  • Integrating robots, PLCs, and other peripheral devices into an automation environment 
  • Supporting electrical commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and on-site customer deployments 
  • Acting as a technical point of contact for robotics and industrial automation across our teams 
  • Bringing practical experience from customer projects into technical and product related decisions 

NOVA & Software Development 
You will use Wandelbots NOVA to implement customer-specific robotics and automation solutions and bring an important application perspective into our product development. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Translating customer robotics requirements into NOVA-based software solutions 
  • Developing project-specific applications, workflows, and functionality using Python 
  • Combining and applying existing NOVA capabilities to real industrial use cases 
  • Working closely with Software, Product, and Robotics Engineering on new use cases and technical challenges
  • Providing structured feedback from real-world projects and turning project learnings into reusable solutions and best practices


Your profile

You have hands-on experience in industrial robotics and automation and enjoy working at the intersection of automation and software. Ideally, you bring: 

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot programming, parameterization, and commissioning 
  • Practical experience with at least one major robot manufacturer such as KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa, FANUC, or Stäubli 
  • Experience with industrial automation systems and customer-site commissioning
  • Basic knowledge of PLC programming and electrical commissioning 
  • Good knowledge of Python 
  • A basic understanding of software architecture and modern development practices 
  • Ideally, a qualification as a certified electrical specialist / qualified electrician or a comparable qualification
  • A hands-on, solution-oriented mindset and openness to modern development and AI assisted tools

  • You enjoy working directly with customers, software developers, and automation specialists 
  • You want to do more than just experiment with new technologies and are motivated to bring them into real production environments 

Why This Role? 

This role combines two areas that are increasingly converging in industrial automation: robotics and software development. You will work with real industrial robots and automation systems while also developing NOVA-based solutions for concrete customer applications. IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Als Anwendungsarchitekt (m/w/d) gehörst du zu unseren ersten Senior-Entwicklern in Vollzeit und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mitgründer und CTO zusammen. Du verantwortest die Backend-Architektur und hilfst dem Team, Qualität und Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit mit dem Wachstum zu steigern.

In den ersten 6–12 Monaten wirst du:

  • eine klare Zielarchitektur und eine solide Dokumentationsgrundlage mit arc42 etablieren;

  • die Zuverlässigkeit und Softwareauslieferung durch bessere CI/CD-Prozesse, Testautomatisierung und eine sauber gepflegte Infrastruktur verbessern.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team überzeugende Lösungen für neuartige Problemstellungen in einer AI-first-Architektur entwickeln.
  • Einen DevOps-orientierten Ansatz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben: von der Spezifikation über die Entwicklung bis zur Auslieferung – inspiriert vom DevOps Handbook.
  • Ansätze vorschlagen und umsetzen, die die Softwareauslieferung schneller und zuverlässiger machen, etwa durch einen besseren Arbeitsfluss, kürzere Feedbackschleifen und eine schnellere Wiederherstellung nach Störungen.
  • Systemübergreifendes Monitoring und Observability aufbauen und weiterentwickeln – einschließlich Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alarmierung –, damit wir Probleme frühzeitig erkennen und aus dem Produktivbetrieb lernen.
  • Junior-Entwickler coachen und gemeinsam mit ihnen bewährte Entwicklungs-, Design- und Architekturpraktiken anwenden.
  • Zusammen mit dem Team einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess gestalten, von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung.
  • Die Backend-Architektur mit dem arc42-Framework planen und dokumentieren.
  • Das Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien erweitern und verständlich vermitteln.
  • Die Anwendungsinfrastruktur auf Azure mit Pulumi verwalten und ausbauen.

Qualifikation

Unverzichtbare Voraussetzungen

  • Erfahrung mit dem arc42-Framework (ISAQB) und C4.
  • Erfahrung darin, Entwicklungsteams zu führen und zu befähigen.
  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Java Spring Boot (MVC, JPA, Security).
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmustern und Domain-Driven Design.
  • Hervorragende Codequalität auf Basis von Clean-Code- und SOLID-Prinzipien.
  • Umfassende Erfahrung mit TDD und BDD.
  • Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung mit React und Angular.

Darüber hinaus überzeugst du mit …

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code auf Azure oder AWS mit Pulumi.
  • Einer ausgeprägten DevOps-Mentalität – das DevOps Handbook ist deine Bibel – und Erfahrung beim Aufbau von:
  • zuverlässigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Release-Prozessen;
  • produktionsreifem Monitoring und Observability sowie Verfahren zur Reaktion auf Betriebsstörungen;
  • kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen, etwa durch die Nachbereitung von Störungen, das Lernen aus dem Betrieb und die Priorisierung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows.
  • IntelliJ-Kenntnissen auf Power-User-Niveau.

Benefits

  • Eigenverantwortliche, praktische Arbeit an einem echten KI-Produkt, das bereits von Unternehmenskunden eingesetzt wird.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam vom ersten Tag an.

  • Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups.
  • Die Möglichkeit, unser KI-Team mitzugestalten, während wir wachsen.

Auxilius ai entwickelt KI-gestützte GRC-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Wir befinden uns in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, wachsen schnell und können bereits auf echte Kunden bauen. Unser Technologie-Stack umfasst Java und Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes auf Azure sowie LLMs von OpenAI und Anthropic.

The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.

  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.

title: Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)
description:
Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Während des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein persönliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B. Produktmanagement, (Produkt-)Marketing, Vertrieb, HR, Logistik, Einzelhandel, etc.). Der Schwerpunkt deines Traineeships ist das Produktmanagement.

Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und Fähigkeiten an.

Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abläufe im Unternehmen.


Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team

#Einkauf:
Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten. 
#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.

Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;) 


Das wünscht sich dein Team:

"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen können."

– Christian

"Wer sich entwickeln will, der kann das hier bei uns, d.h. aber auch, dass man dies wollen und zeigen muss."

– Robert

"Mir ist es wichtig, dass man sich mit dem Job und NBB identifiziert und wir alle an einem Strang ziehen."

– Manuela

Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

Als Senior Vendor Manager / Lieferantenmanager Telekommunikation (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Glasfaserausbau von OXG. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Bau- und Ausbaupartner zuverlässig, qualitativ hochwertig und wirtschaftlich arbeiten – und bringst gleichzeitig moderne Tools und KI‑Ansätze in unser Lieferantenmanagement ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Baupartnern zusammen, um die Qualität ihrer Leistungen und Produkte innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeit- und Budgetziele sicherzustellen. 
  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Ausbaupartnern reviewst du regelmäßig und engmaschig Qualität und Lieferleistung: Du überwachst die Performance verschiedener Partner und Lieferanten und treibst die  Entwicklung und Implementierung von Maßnahmen voran, um Prozesse und Produktivität kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Du gehst Qualitätsabweichungen bei Partnern systematisch nach und identifizierst Ursachen und stellst sicher, dass Maßnahmenpläne entwickelt und fristgerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der gesamten Prozesskette – von Planung, über Bau (NE3) bis Umsetzung vor Ort (NE4) und Dokumentation – und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit unseren internen und externen Stakeholdern um.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und dem Etablieren KI‑gestützter Monitoring‑ und Reportingansätze für das Vendor Management (z.B. für Partner-Performance, Risikofrüherkennung, Forecasting, Qualitätsmanagement) und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter.
  • Du übernimmst eine wichtige Rolle in der Risikosteuerung: Dazu gehört insbesondere der professionelle Umgang mit insolvenzgefährdeten Partnerunternehmen und deren Nachunternehmern, inklusive Bewertung, Neuaufstellung und Übergangsszenarien.
  • Du bist Teil eines dynamischen Teams, in dem ihr systematisch Erfahrungen teilt und Best-Practices identifiziert und organisationsweit implementiert 


Wann passt Du zu uns?

  • Du hast mindesten 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lieferantenbetreuung bzw. im Vendor Management, idealerweise im Telekommunikations- oder Glasfaser-Umfeld.
