title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline

Wir sind ein modernes IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen und unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Betrieb sowie der Weiterentwicklung anspruchsvoller Infrastruktur- und Cloud-Umgebungen. Unser Fokus liegt auf nachhaltigen IT-Lösungen, Automatisierung, Security und Betriebskonzepten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Linux- und Netzwerk-Spezialisten, der sich für moderne Infrastruktur, Automatisierung und Security begeistert. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte, viel Eigenverantwortung und ein hoher Homeoffice-Anteil.

Aufgaben

  • Administration, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von Linux-Servern mit Schwerpunkt Red Hat Enterprise Linux
  • Betreuung von Netzwerk- und Security-Infrastrukturen
  • Konfiguration und Betrieb von Firewalls, VPN- und Remote-Access-Lösungen
  • Verwaltung und Optimierung von Load-Balancern und Reverse-Proxys
  • Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen mit Ansible und weiteren Werkzeugen
  • Betrieb von Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen
  • Analyse und Behebung komplexer Störungen in Kundenumgebungen
  • Unterstützung bei Architektur-, Migrations- und Modernisierungsprojekten
  • Dokumentation von Systemen und Prozessen
  • Gelegentliche Einsätze beim Kunden vor Ort oder im Rechenzentrum

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von Linux-Systemen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Red Hat Enterprise Linux oder vergleichbaren Distributionen
  • Erfahrung mit Firewalls, Routing, Switching und Netzwerksicherheit
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Ansible und Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Erfahrung im Betrieb hochverfügbarer Umgebungen
  • Kenntnisse in HAProxy, Red Hat Satellite oder ähnlichen Technologien von Vorteil
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, Container-Plattformen oder DevOps-Werkzeugen
  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

  • Überwiegend Homeoffice
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung
  • Spannende Kundenprojekte mit aktuellen Technologien
  • Umfangreiche Fortbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten
  • Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Kollegiales und technisch starkes Team
  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

Du möchtest moderne Linux-, Netzwerk- und Security-Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestalten und suchst eine Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Praktikant Online Marketing & Content (w/m/d)
description:
Die Spread Group ist ein international agierendes Lifestyle- und Fashion-Tech-Unternehmen. Wir setzen auf einfach individualisierbare Produkte, die exakt den Vorstellungen unserer Kund*innen entsprechen. Als Vorreiter im Bereich der Made-to-Order Technologien verbinden wir Nachhaltigkeit mit passgenauen Lösungen. Ob für Privatpersonen oder Unternehmen – bei uns bekommt Fashion ihren individuellen Ausdruck. Wir machen die Einzigartigkeit jedes Menschen mit individueller Fashion sichtbar.

Wir sind auf dem Weg, die Fashion-Branche ressourcenschonend neu zu gestalten, mit innovativen Denkansätzen und digitalen Lösungen für die herausfordernden Fragen unserer Zeit.

Dafür suchen wir engagierte Talente wie dich: Bereichere als Praktikant*in Online Marketing & Content (w/m/d) unser dynamisches Team und lass uns gemeinsam innovative Lösungen entwickeln.

 

Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitposition im Rahmen eines Pflichtpraktikums oder freiwilligen Praktikums und bietet die Flexibilität in unserem Leipziger Headquarter zu arbeiten.

 

Über die Rolle

Unser External Marketplaces Team ist für die Präsentation und Vermarktung des stetig wachsenden Angebots an Produkten und Designs auf den bedeutendsten Online-Marktplätzen, wie Amazon und eBay, verantwortlich. Zur Unterstützung im Bereich Online Marketing suchen wir dich ab sofort für 3-6 Monate.

 

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Du unterstützt uns bei der Erweiterung und Optimierung unserer Angebote aus den Bereichen Licensing, Marketplace und Personalisierung

  • Du kümmerst dich um die Bearbeitung personalisierter Bestellungen von Amazon

  • Du erstellst kreative Inhalte für unsere Amazon Brand Stores, die Kund*innen begeistern und unsere Marke stärken

  • Du recherchierst zu aktuellen Themen und Trends aus den Bereichen Licensing und Bekleidung

  • Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team an der Umsetzung neuer Projekte

 

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du studierst BWL, Medien- und Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einen anderen relevanten Studiengang und interessierst dich für den Bereich Marketing

  • Du liebst Teamwork und arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig

  • Du kannst sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich sicher in Deutsch (und Englisch) kommunizieren; Kenntnisse in Französisch sind von Vorteil

  • Du bringst analytisches Verständnis mit und verfügst über gute Excel Kenntnisse Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in Adobe Photoshop und Illustrator? Super, aber kein Muss

Was wir dir bieten 

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote innerhalb von Deutschland zu arbeiten. Basierend auf gegenseitigem Vertrauen findest du so zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance, die deinen persönlichen Bedürfnissen entspricht.

  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Profitiere von großzügigen 30 Urlaubstagen jährlich und genieße familienfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen, die dir kostbare Momente mit deinen Lieben schenken.

  • Transparenz und Wachstum: Besuche unsere regelmäßigen General Assemblies, um Teil unserer Vision zu sein, zu der du beiträgst. Profitiere von unserem umfangreichen Onboarding-Programm und besuche unsere Produktionsstätte in der Tschechischen Republik, um dein Verständnis für unsere Prozesse von Anfang an zu vertiefen.

  • Lernen und wachsen: Erweitere deine Skills mit Deutsch- und Englischkursen, interdisziplinären Workshops und Trainings, die deine berufliche Entwicklung fördern.

  • Vorteile, die Freude machen: Freu dich auf zahlreiche exklusive Vorteile bei vielen bekannten Marken und Partnerunternehmen sowie Rabatte auf unsere eigenen Produkte. Genieße zudem Zugang zu Rabattaktionen, die direkt auf dich zugeschnitten sind.

  • Inspirierende Räume: Arbeite in modernen, inspirierenden Büros mit Dachterrasse und gemütlichen Küchen für Pausen und After-Work-Events.

  • Feiere den Erfolg: Nimm an unseren unvergesslichen Firmenevents teil, von legendären Sommer- und Weihnachtspartys bis hin zu spannenden Team-building Aktivitäten und inspirierenden Workshops.

  • Sei Du selbst: Freu dich auf eine herzliche und offene Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der Authentizität gefeiert wird und kein Dresscode dich einschränkt. Selbstverständlich ist auch dein vierbeiniger Freund willkommen.

Chancengleichheit 

Spread Group steht für Vielfalt. Wir sind stolz auf die stetig wachsende Diversität unseres Unternehmens und fördern sie aktiv. Dabei liegt unser Fokus auf Deinen Fähigkeiten, Talenten und Erfahrungen – unabhängig von Alter, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Familienstand oder Behinderung.

title: Senior Director, People & Culture
description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT BUILDING LEADERS, SHAPING CULTURE, AND ENABLING BUSINESS SUCCESS

The Senior Director, People & Culture is a pivotal senior role within our London Office and a key member of Catapult's global P&C leadership team. Working three days in the office and partnering closely with senior business leaders, you will drive strategic impact while shaping both the culture and operational effectiveness of the EMEA region.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, based in Melbourne, you will lead an in-region team of three and be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enable, engage, develop and retain exceptional talent.

Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution. You will thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and be energised by creating innovative, scalable solutions that strengthen leadership capability and foster a high-performance culture across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Develop and execute strategic workforce plans, coaching senior leaders on organisational design, change management, communication, and talent development to drive engagement, retention, and business performance.
  • Shape culture and values by identifying organisational needs and implementing impactful, scalable people solutions.
  • Drive a consistent, high-quality employee experience across the EMEA region, spanning three offices, 16 countries, and multiple employment frameworks.
  • Provide hands-on support and strategic partnership to leaders, teams, and employees, ensuring people strategies are aligned with business goals.
  • Partner with the Talent team to deliver strategic initiatives across learning and development, diversity, equity and inclusion, reward, workforce planning, and talent acquisition.
  • Mentor and lead regional P&C team members, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Leverage data and insights to identify trends, inform decision-making, and influence strategic outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A commercial mindset and the ability to connect people decisions to business outcomes, building credibility and influence with senior leaders across regions and cultures.
  • Significant People & Culture leadership experience in a multi-country EMEA environment, with working knowledge of UK and German employment law.
  • Proven success partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth, global organisation to drive transformation and business outcomes.
  • The ability to balance competing priorities across the employee lifecycle without compromising quality or attention to detail.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex challenges.
  • A strategic yet hands-on approach, balancing pace with employee development, engagement, and belonging.
  • Experience designing creative, commercially driven solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • A passion for creating a market-leading employee experience and fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Flexibility to work across global time zones when required.

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months, you have built strong relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders and are recognised as a trusted P&C partner. You have a clear understanding of workforce opportunities, challenges, and priorities, with a defined view of how P&C can enable business performance. Your direct team is aligned on priorities, ways of working, and expectations, and regional P&C processes are operating with consistency and quality.
  • In 12 months time, you are driving meaningful impact through strategic workforce initiatives, stronger leadership capability, and an enhanced employee experience. Leaders are empowered to navigate people challenges effectively, global P&C initiatives are successfully embedded across teams, and data and insights are being used to inform decisions. You are a valued member of the global P&C leadership team, helping shape and deliver a high-performance culture across Catapult.

 

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 5000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead design for Paddle's Core Experience team, the horizontal team responsible for the foundations every other product is built on: sign-up, onboarding, the design system, and the overall Seller Experience. The Core Experience team owns the connective, cross-cutting experience that ties Paddle's products together.

This is a different kind of design role. Rather than owning a single product surface, you'll own the connective tissue that makes Paddle feel like one coherent product. When a seller signs up, gets onboarded, moves between products, or encounters an AI-powered or integrated experience, your work is what makes it feel effortless.

You'll be an active contributor to Paddle's integration and AI experiences, helping shape how Paddle connects to the wider tooling ecosystem and where AI genuinely improves the seller experience. This role asks for exceptional UI craft, deep design systems expertise, and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change both the products we build and the way we design them.

As a holistic problem solver, you'll operate well beyond pixels, balancing hands-on execution with systems thinking, influence, and a high bar for quality. Embedded in a cross-functional team alongside Product and Engineering, you'll work in an environment that values ownership, autonomy, and accountability.

What you'll do:

  • Own the end-to-end design of Paddle's foundational seller experiences, sign-up, onboarding, and the surfaces that connect our products together, from discovery and concepting through delivery, iteration, and long-term evolution.

  • Act as a horizontal partner to all other product teams, creating the guidelines, principles, and reusable patterns that keep the experience consistent across the platform as Paddle grows.

  • Contribute actively to integration and AI experiences, shaping interaction patterns and surfaces, and forming a clear point of view on where AI delivers real user value (and where it gets in the way).

  • Lead design thinking for foundational work, including information architecture, interaction patterns, accessibility, and scalable component design.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Stakeholders to define problems, shape solutions, influence roadmaps, and ship high-quality outcomes.

  • Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate decisions and continuously improve the experience.

  • Set and uphold quality and craft standards across the product organisation, advocating for user-centred design and a high design bar.

  • Use storytelling to build alignment and secure buy-in for foundational, cross-cutting work that often spans many teams.

  • Mentor and support other designers through collaboration, feedback, and critique.

  • Own and improve the customer experience across a complex B2B platform used by thousands of SaaS companies and millions of their customers.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Bring a strong portfolio with exceptional UI craft, showcasing end-to-end product design with clear problem-solving, interaction design, and visual clarity in complex domains.

  • Have proven experience owning, building, and maintaining design systems, leading their direction, designing components, writing documentation, establishing governance, and driving adoption across teams.

  • Are curious about adopting AI in the design process and in the products you build, and can critically assess where AI delivers real user value and translate it into thoughtful, usable experiences.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

 

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc. a Design & AI Task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder.

 

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

What you'll own

When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven.

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

title: Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Lendable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

  1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
description:
About us
We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

The role
You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops.

What you'll do

  • Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics

  • Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction

  • Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models

  • Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out

Essential experience.

  • Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods

  • A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity

  • Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost

Highly preferred

  • Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization

  • You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before

  • Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML

Logistics

Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate.

title: Engineering Manager – United Kingdom
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

  • Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.

  • Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.

  • Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

  • Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

  • Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

  • Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

  • Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

title: Développeur Full Stack JS
description:
Demain, notre console recevra des milliards de requêtes. Votre mission : faire en sorte qu’elle tienne, et qu’elle reste rapide. Arkane Cloud crée un poste de Développeur Full Stack, à 80 % back-end, pour bâtir une plateforme taillée pour la charge.

 

Notre société

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

  • Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler

  • Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

 

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre console est le point d’entrée de nos clients : c’est là qu’ils déploient et pilotent leurs ressources GPU. Avec l’essor de l’IA, elle va devoir absorber une très grande quantité de requêtes. Nous créons ce poste pour la rendre robuste face aux pics de charge, développer les API qui la font tourner et installer les bonnes pratiques qui permettront à l’équipe de grandir. Votre temps se partage à 80 % sur le back-end et 20 % sur le front-end.

 

Vos missions

• Tenir les pics de charge : une architecture qui absorbe le trafic sans ralentir.

• Développer nos API en Node.js : performantes, sécurisées, documentées.

• Installer les bonnes pratiques : revues de code, tests automatisés, monitoring.

• Optimiser la base de données PostgreSQL.

• Faire évoluer l’interface de la console en React.js (environ 20 % du temps).

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

1er mois : Prise en main de la console et de son architecture, premier audit de performance, premières mises en production.

3 mois : Tests de charge en place, premiers points de blocage corrigés, bonnes pratiques formalisées.

6 mois : Console capable d’absorber n'importe quelle montée en charge, monitoring et alertes opérationnels.

 

Votre expérience

• 5 ans ou plus en développement, avec une dominante back-end.

• Une expérience sur une plateforme grand public ou à fort trafic.

Vos expertises

• Node.js : conception d’API robustes et performantes.

• React.js : à l’aise pour faire évoluer une interface existante.

• Montée en charge : cache, files d’attente, tests de charge, scalabilité.

Un vrai plus :

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Votre façon de travailler : rigoureux sur la qualité, pragmatique, à l’aise pour partager vos pratiques avec l’équipe.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Un vrai défi technique : S'assurer de la robuste de la plateforme lors des montées en charge

• Un impact direct : Vos choix d’architecture façonnent la plateforme.

• Des standards à poser : c’est vous qui fixez le niveau d’exigence de l’équipe.

• Au cœur de l’IA : vos API pilotent une infrastructure GPU dédiée à l’IA.

 

Package et avantages

• Télétravail 3 jours par semaine, présence au bureau de Lyon le mercredi et le jeudi

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

• Choix du matériel (PC ou Mac) & BSPCE

 

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

 

Compensation: €45K – €65K

title: Web Designer | UX/UI
description:
Notre site, notre charte graphique, notre console : tout est à redessiner, et c’est vous qui tiendrez le crayon. Arkane Cloud crée son premier poste de Web Designer pour donner à l’infrastructure IA une image à la hauteur de ses ambitions.

Notre société

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

  • Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler

  • Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

 

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Arkane Cloud grandit vite, et notre image doit suivre : charte, site et console se sont construits au fil de l’eau, sans designer dédié. Ce poste est créé pour poser des fondations solides : une identité cohérente, un site qui donne envie et une console aussi simple que notre infrastructure est puissante. Vous rejoignez l’équipe Engineering, aux côtés des développeurs qui intégreront vos maquettes, en lien étroit avec le marketing.

 

Vos missions

  1. Refondre le site web, du wireframe à la mise en ligne.

  2. Faire évoluer la charte graphique et la décliner sur tous nos supports.

  3. Repenser l’interface de la console, de l’inscription au pilotage des GPU.

  4. Construire notre design system avec les développeurs.

  5. Appuyer le marketing et les projets internes.

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

1er mois : audit du site, de la charte et de la console, rencontre des équipes et de quelques clients.

3 mois : nouvelle charte graphique validée et maquettes du nouveau site.

6 mois : nouveau site en ligne, premiers composants du design system et premières améliorations de la console.

 

Votre expérience

• 5 ans ou plus en web design et UI/UX, chez un éditeur SaaS ou en agence pour des clients tech.

• Un portfolio avec au moins une refonte de site et une interface produit.

 

Vos expertises

• Figma (composants, variants, auto-layout) et Framer.

• UI/UX : parcours utilisateurs, wireframes, tests.

• Création et maintenance d’un design system.

• Une culture front-end suffisante pour parler le langage des développeurs.

Un vrai plus :

  • Intégration de maquettes dans un environnement React/Nextjs

  • Connaissance de Git et des bonnes pratiques logicielles

  • Création de design responsive

Votre façon de travailler : autonome, pédagogue, exigeant sur le détail et curieux de l’IA.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Une page blanche : premier designer, vous définissez l’identité visuelle d’Arkane Cloud.

• Un vrai défi : rendre simple et désirable une infrastructure GPU.

• Au cœur de l’équipe tech : un cycle court entre l’idée et la mise en ligne.

• Un secteur qui compte : l’infrastructure IA et la souveraineté européenne.

 

Package et avantages

• [45 – 65k€ brut annuel] selon expérience

• Télétravail 3 jours par semaine, avec de la souplesse pour vos contraintes personnelles

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

• Choix de votre matériel, BSPCE

 

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

 

Compensation: €45K – €65K

title: Business Development Manager (AI Data Solutions)
description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? This role

will focus on developing new business relationships and act as a strategic customer partner within the AI Solutions group (DataForce). DataForce is a rapidly growing service offering high quality data for Human Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching and processing training data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.

DataForce is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide and we are recruiting globally.

Key position responsibilities:

• Identify potential clients in the target market and complete appropriate research on the prospective client’s business and technical needs

• Identify, qualify and quantify opportunities

• Drive opportunities from lead generation all the way to closure

• Ensure customer success and satisfaction

• Draft and implement business plans

• Understand client’s business and technical requirements

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date on industry news

• Keep track of business opportunities on TransPerfect’s CRM system

• Coordinate production and technology teams across different time zones and cultures

• Generate and manage high-value profitable business deals

• Identify, track and manage KPIs and provide internal and client facing status reports; providing of executive updates including account progress, health, risk and opportunities

• Attend tradeshows and support marketing efforts by contributing to case studies and social media

• Provide accurate weekly forecasts and daily update reports

• Assist in building overall plans/budgets and subsequent adherence; own the overall financial health of assigned client engagements; drive efficiencies across process, people and technology

• Manage stakeholder communication around owned business and accounts

• Assist in training and adoption of technologies and services for internal and client teams

• Propose and implement new innovative offerings


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior communication skills

  • Proven track record in achieving sales target within the AI industry

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
description:
About H:

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

  • Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

  • Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

  • Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

  • Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

 

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

  • Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

  • Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

  • Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

  • Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have

  • Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

  • Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

  • Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.

  • Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

  • Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

 

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 

How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

 

Practicalities

Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.

title: Automation Lead
description:
About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.
